identification: Cased 24-piece fruit service, 12 knives and 12 forks, mother-of-pearl handles, engine-turned/textured ferrules with beaded collars, knife blades with etched/engraved foliate decoration, three-tine forks with baluster necks. Oak case (plain oval brass lid cartouche, vacant), black velvet fitted interior in two tiers, retailer's label 'GIBSON & Co BELFAST' (Belfast jewellers), brass lock stamped 'BRITISH MADE' with a circled K, which points to c.1920s-1950s rather than Edwardian. All 24 pieces present. Estimate A$30-40, current bid A$20.

viewing_check: Turn several knives and forks over and loupe the ferrule backs and blade ricassos: a lion passant + Sheffield crown/Birmingham anchor + date letter means silver (max A$110); 'EPNS', 'A1', 'Stainless' or nothing means plate (max 0). Check MOP for cracks or lifting and blades for pitting.
